name: 6s

images.credit: Rafael Fernandez, CC BY-SA 4.0 via Wikimedia Commons

Network.Technology: GSM, CDMA, 3G, EVDO, HSPA+, LTE/4G, LTE Advanced/4G+

Body.Other: FaceTime audio or video, Voice over LTE

Memory.Storage: 16, 32, 64 or 128 GB TLC NAND connected via NVMe

Display.Display: 6s: 4.7 in Retina HD, LED-backlit IPS LCD, 1334 × 750 pixel resolution (326 ppi), 6s Plus: 5.5 in Retina HD, LED-backlit IPS LCD, 1920 × 1080 pixel resolution (401 ppi), 500 cd/m2 max brightness (typical)

Cameras.Rear camera: Sony Exmor RS IMX315 12 MP (1.22 μm), true-tone flash, autofocus, IR filter, burst mode, 4K video recording at 30 fps or 1080p at 30 or 60 fps, slow-motion video (1080p at 120 fps and 720p at 240 fps), timelapse with stabilization, panorama (up to 63 megapixels), face detection, digital image stabilization, optical image stabilization (6s Plus only)
Cameras.Front camera: 5 MP, burst mode, exposure control, face detection, auto-HDR, 720p HD video recording, Retina flash

Sound.Sound: Mono speaker, 3.5 mm stereo audio jack

Battery.Battery: 6s: 3.82 V 6.55 W·h (1715 mA·h) Lithium polymer battery, Li-Po, 6s Plus: 3.8 V 10.45 W·h (2750 mA·h) Li-Po
